newsitem.title: FRANCE: Meteorite hits car in France - radio.
newsitem.headline: Meteorite hits car in France - radio.

text.p: A meteorite hit a car and set it on fire in the French Alpine town of Chambery on Friday, French radio said.

France-Inter radio said firemen found a piece of smoking molten material on the roof of the car, and local university scientists identified it as a 1.5 kg (three lb) block of basalt magma from outer space.
"It looked like soot. What was strange was that there was something like ice, small bits of black ice which were melting," a fireman said.
